goal: Make MFM context source- and time-bound without giving the learned model speaker, subject, consent or Claim authority.
procedure: Version the packet to carry source item, speaker, subject, event/record time, duplicate group and parent lineage. Let arbitrary memory planes propose source IDs. Resolve each ID through a separately registered same-host source; check current policy before and after custody read; verify exact bytes and source registration; record a content-free receipt of the sources delivered. Reject foreign, forged, future-recorded, revoked and changed evidence.
authority: Implements model-input source and permission checks only; independent authentication, Claim adjudication and production backend qualification remain separate.
validation: 24 focused formation contract tests passed on the exact MFM tree 8b2704ce8abb61cb2ea24e61fef0169d5d12bb31, including forged role, read-time revocation, foreign host, altered bytes, future record and multi-plane source routing. No real selected backend or learned model run.
failure_or_lesson: The previous packet omitted speaker, source lineage and time. Text alone could not distinguish owner speech from quotation or a changed preference. The interface required a versioned source metadata change rather than a prompt hotfix.

goal: Create traceable multi-host formation contract cases and prevent a tiny public fixture from being mistaken for full-scale learned MFM qualification.
procedure: Author distinct fictional host histories with explicit source content, roles, subjects, times, supported proposals, critical forbidden memories and checkable reasons. Split by host and source family; freeze exact bytes; validate labels through the same formation evidence binding as inference; reject duplicated source content across splits. Expose only train rows to optimizers and run supplied artifact outputs on development or challenge, retaining each critical failure separately.
authority: Contract and evaluation material only. The harness oracle is a test double, not a learned MFM. No training authorization, memory promotion or full Stage G qualification.
validation: Frozen SHA-256 312b0f8a826ca83a0cae1db105e39a9addcd24cef98c74c2ef84f971db95d85c; 11 cases across three disjoint fictional hosts; 24 focused tests passed. Only three train cases, no independent adjudication, generator-family holdout or sealed final. No PyTorch/backbone/GPU in this workspace. No gradient run or downstream native judgment result.
failure_or_lesson: A host-disjoint public fixture catches contract errors but cannot teach or certify full memory formation. An apparent perfect score from a harness oracle is evaluation wiring, not model capability. Preserve the failed training-admission boundary instead of training a memorizer and calling it MFM.
